system.description:
Reaching into a living or undead body, you wrench the soul free, casting it out as a wraith and leaving the flesh an empty husk.

Expend a Willpower Trait and engage your target in a Social Challenge, retesting with Occult. If you succeed, the soul is torn from the body and forced to remain as a ghost for a full hour or scene, during which you may bind it with other Necromancy powers. The vacated body survives in a comatose state, a perfect host for another possessing spirit.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
